semiconductor_relevance: High — AfaPa Vacuum specializes in vacuum equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai AfaPa Vacuum Equipment Co., Ltd is a leading manufacturer of dry, oil-free vacuum pumps and related equipment, providing solutions for semiconductor fabrication. With a focus on eco-friendly technology, AfaPa offers high-quality vacuum systems that are integral to various semiconductor processes.

regional_presence.China: AfaPa has manufacturing bases in Yangzhou and Yancheng, along with a Shanghai engineering service center.
